mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS id, BIN_TO_UUID(problem_id) AS problem_id, status, storage_ref, LOWER(HEX(content_sha256)) AS content_sha256, case_count, total_bytes, CAST(manifest_json AS CHAR) AS manifest_json, created_at, ready_at, error_message
mapper.select: SELECT FROM test_data_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM test_data_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
SELECT FROM test_data_version WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status = 'READY' AND content_sha256 = UNHEX(#{sha256}) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_data_version (id, problem_id, status, source_type, storage_ref, content_sha256, case_count, total_bytes, manifest_json, created_by, created_at, ready_at, error_message) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}), 'UPLOADING', 'MANUAL_UPLOAD', #{storageRef}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, UUID_TO_BIN(#{createdBy}), #{createdAt}, NULL, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE test_data_version SET status = 'READY', content_sha256 = UNHEX(#{sha256}), case_count = #{caseCount}, total_bytes = #{totalBytes}, manifest_json = #{manifestJson}, ready_at = #{readyAt}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'UPLOADING'
UPDATE test_data_version SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'UPLOADING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM test_data_version WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'UPLOADING'
mapper.update: UPDATE problem_version SET test_data_version_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{testDataVersionId}), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{versionId}) AND problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) AND status = 'DRAFT' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT storage_ref FROM test_data_version WHERE status = 'READY'
mapper.update: UPDATE test_data_version SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage} WHERE status = 'UPLOADING' AND created_at < #{cutoff}
